strapiBlog.title: Arada Unveils Akala in Dubai Real Estate: World’s First Precision Wellness Destination
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai's skyline is about to soar to spectacular new heights with the unveiling of the Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai.

data.text:
Sharjah-based developer Arada has officially launched the Akala project Dubai in Zabeel 2. It is a twin-tower development set to rise between Dubai International Financial Center (DIFC) and Downtown Dubai. More than just a high-rise, Akala Hotel & Residences is a purpose-built address focused on wellness and refined urban living. Each 220-meter tower is designed to offer residents an experience that integrates health, hospitality, and architecture, elevating the way we think about home.

Here's everything you need to know about this upcoming project in Dubai.

About Akala by Arada

Launching on 31st May 2025, Akala by Arada is part of a growing wave of Dubai off-plan developments attracting both lifestyle seekers and savvy investors. Priced from AED 3.79 million, these residences feature spacious 1-bedroom apartments starting at 1,036 sq ft. The standout? A six-bedroom penthouse commanding a price of AED 150 million and covering a breathtaking 23,673 sq ft.

The name Akala, derived from Sanskrit, meaning “beyond time,” is a fitting reflection of Arada’s vision. Akala by Arada is designed to be more than a home; it’s a sanctuary for peak health, optimal performance, and restorative rest. Whether you’re investing or planning to live in Dubai, this project offers unmatched value through lifestyle-centric design and futuristic wellness amenities.

Arada Akala Dubai Features

Arada Akala Dubai will feature a full-service luxury hotel and branded residences, redefining urban living through holistic wellness. With organic dining, air purification systems, circadian lighting, and personalized health services, Akala blends cutting-edge science with thoughtful design, making it a one-of-a-kind offering in Dubai’s property market.

Among the many real estate projects Dubai is currently developing, Akala stands tall as a lifestyle choice backed by purpose and precision. Set along Sheikh Zayed Road, this twin-tower marvel joins elite neighbors like Emirates Towers and One Za’abeel, making it a strategic and iconic location for residents and investors alike.

faqs.question: When does the Akala by Arada sales launch start?
What’s the price range for apartments in Arada Akala Dubai?

data.answer: Prices start from AED 3.79 million for a 1-bedroom apartment, with premium penthouses going up to AED 150 million.

faqs.question: Is Akala part of the new Arada project 2025 pipeline?

data.answer: Yes, Akala is Arada’s headline launch for 2025, expanding the developer’s footprint in Dubai.
